decided_by: Nguyen Duc Manh (owner + tech lead), on chief E2 issuance 2026-09-10 + recall-lock decision 2026-09-09
title: Recall-risk consumer (M6 side): pull ops-core availability (A), map to risk_flags per E2 §3, recall_case_open folded into recall, fail-closed
decision: M6 consumes ops-core recall / sale-lock / quality risk via the PULL path (POST /v1/availability/check, the authoritative source; event-stream is advisory only). A mapper translates the availability response into the existing Scale-Gate risk_flags: risk_flags['recall'] = recall_hold OR recall_case_open; risk_flags['sale_lock'] = sale_lock; risk_flags['quality_hold'] = quality_hold. M6 reads the presence BOOLEANS only, never decision / block_reasons (those answer M3's sales question). Any presence-flag true makes the Scale-Gate Risk row FAIL even when decision == SELLABLE (clean-lot case) - advertising a SKU with a held lot is a legal/reputational risk distinct from selling the remaining clean lot. A pull error / timeout / 429 yields an INCOMPLETE (unknown) risk read, so the gate's existing fail-closed re-check (RULE-017) refuses to clear -> FAIL; a running campaign reads 'khong xac minh duoc', never auto-clear, never auto-pause.
availability_response_shape_consumed: from ops-core contract pin ginsengfood-contracts@a413f1f (POST /v1/availability/check; pin bumped from 79f73d2 on 2026-09-10 for the recall_case_open field) + E2_BLOCK_REASON_V1 2026-09-10 §1/§2: data.decision in {SELLABLE, NOT_SELLABLE}; presence booleans data.recall_hold / data.sale_lock / data.quality_hold; additive data.recall_case_open (absent until ops-core ships it -> treated false; other flags unaffected). M6 uses recall_hold / sale_lock / quality_hold / recall_case_open only.
authority_basis: E2 block_reason vocabulary + M6 gate rule issued by chief 2026-09-10 (canonical, E2_BLOCK_REASON_V1.md §3/§5); recall-lock Q1=A (pull) + Q2=(b) recall_case_open decided by owner/tech-lead 2026-09-09 (ops-core response PHAN_HOI_ket-noi-M6-opscore_09-09.md); ops-core contract pin ginsengfood-contracts@a413f1f (was 79f73d2; bumped 2026-09-10 when recall_case_open shipped).
